originalTitle: Uber shares drop 6% as weak forecast overshadows strong bookings
simplifiedContent: Uber's stock price went down 6% because the company said it doesn't expect to do as well in the future as investors had hoped. This happened even though Uber had a strong second quarter with good growth. The company's forecast, or prediction, for the future was weaker than expected, which worried investors. This weak forecast was more important to investors than the company's good recent performance, which is why the stock price dropped. Uber is also spending more money on self-driving cars, which may be part of its plans for the future.

originalTitle: Thomson Reuters lifts full-year revenue forecast with focus on AI rollout
simplifiedContent: Thomson Reuters, a big company, just said it thinks it will make more money this year than it thought before. It had a great second quarter, with revenue (the amount of money it made) growing 9% to $1.95 billion. The company's profit per share was also higher than expected, which is good news for investors. The company is planning to invest a lot in artificial intelligence (AI) to improve its products and find new ways to make money. This matters because it could help the company grow and make even more money in the future.

originalTitle: SpaceX shares slump 12% as AI spending worries overshadow early returns
simplifiedContent: SpaceX's stock price fell by 12% because investors are worried about how the company will pay for its data centers, even though its investments in artificial intelligence (AI) are already showing good results. The company's AI revenue has increased by more than three times, which is a positive sign. Additionally, SpaceX has announced new agreements related to cloud services. Despite these successes, investors are still concerned about the high cost of SpaceX's AI investments. This concern is overshadowing the company's early successes, causing its stock price to drop.

originalTitle: SpaceX shares plunge 13% as AI spending overshadows earnings beat; down over 50% from post-listing peak
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: SpaceX's stock price dropped 13% to $109.21, which means the value of the company's shares decreased. This happened even though the company made more money than expected. Investors are worried because SpaceX spent a lot of money, $18.4 billion, on artificial intelligence (AI) and this is affecting the company's cash flow. The AI part of the business also lost $1.26 billion, which is a significant loss. Overall, SpaceX's stock price has fallen 40% since the company first started selling shares to the public.

originalTitle: Wall Street advances on Iran deal hopes, SpaceX and AMD dip
simplifiedContent: The stock market had a good day, with three important groups of stocks (the Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite) all going up. The Dow Jones increased by 0.33%, the S&P 500 by 0.45%, and the Nasdaq Composite by 0.43%. This happened because investors are hopeful about a possible deal with Iran, which could be good for the economy. Meanwhile, two specific companies, SpaceX and AMD, did not do well. The overall rise in the stock market is a positive sign, indicating that investors are feeling optimistic.

originalTitle: PB Fintech Q1 Results: Net profit nearly doubles to  ₹163 crore; revenue climbs 40%
simplifiedContent: PB Fintech, a company, just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year. Its net profit, which is the amount of money it made after expenses, was ₹163 crore, almost double what it was last year. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it brought in, also increased by 40% compared to last year, reaching ₹1,888 crore. However, both profit and revenue were lower than the previous quarter. This matters because it shows how well the company is doing financially, which can affect its stock price and be important for investors to know.
